children: The annual inflation rate inched up to 4.4% in August 2026 from 4.3% in July and below the expected 4.5%.
Transportation remained the main source of upward pressure, with prices rising 8.8% year-on-year, after an 8.9% advance in July.
Petrol prices fell 2.0% between July and August, while diesel prices rose 3.1%.
At the same time, food price inflation (1.1% vs 0.9%) quickened for the first time in nine months.
Meanwhile, core inflation, which excludes prices of food, non-alcoholic beverages, fuel, and energy, eased to 4.1% from a two-year high of 4.2% in July and slightly below the expected 4.2%.
On a monthly basis, the CPI was flat in August, after increasing by 0.2% in the month before.

title: South Africa Inflation Rate Below Forecasts at 4.4%
